sections.heading: Business
sections.markdown: Consumer Defensive / Packaged Foods · Indonesia. PT Indofood CBP Sukses Makmur Tbk produces and sells food products in Indonesia, the rest of Asia, Africa, and internationally. It operates through six segments: Noodles Division, Dairy Division (dairy products), Food Seasonings Division, Snack Foods Division, Nutrition and Special Foods Division, and Beverages Division.
